summary: The candidate overlaps independent repository batch reads in `PassLiveInputs.prime` after one sequential probe, bounds both batch and fallback reads at four in flight, keeps per-repository fallback priming serial, and adds fake-port regression tests for the saved read round, bounded concurrency, and deadline admission. No introduced behavioral defect was found; the fix is a focused latency reduction for the repair input gate.

evidence: `src/repair/loop-live-inputs.ts` 108-142 keep the first repository read as a sequential probe, then run the remaining independent repository batch reads with at most four in flight and prime per-repository fallbacks serially.

`tests/repair/loop-input-gate_test.ts` 491-640 add fake-port regressions: three repository reads take two rounds instead of three (509-512), all batch and fallback pools stay bounded at four (590-607), and no read is admitted at the run deadline (621-640).
The change is confined to the repair live-input read path and its tests, so throughput thresholds, native review, CI and accounting gates are untouched, matching the done-when constraints.
